card.name: Just before toxicity or safety wording
card.fires_on: Linking words and word starts that come right before a toxicology term, such as 'non' + clinical, 'ANIMAL TOXICOLOGY AND', or 'in a' before 'toxicity study'. It appears in animal-study and nonclinical toxicology passages of drug labels.

modes.label: Nonclinical study wording
modes.description: Responds to 'clinical' or 'long-term' after 'non' or 'No long' when animal studies are being described.
modes.example: In non<<clinical>> studies, there was no evidence of toxicity

modes.label: Toxicology section headings
modes.description: Responds to the joining word or bracket inside headings like Animal Toxicology and Pharmacology or Nonclinical Toxicology.

modes.label: Linking words before study types
modes.description: Responds to small words such as 'a', 'animal' or 'see' just before a toxicity study or cross-reference.
modes.example: in<< a>> 52-week toxicity study of oral

card.writes: It pushes the model toward saying safety, toxic or toxicity next.
card.plain: It fires on the words leading into a toxicity or safety study mention in animal and nonclinical sections.
